description: Work out customer acquisition cost (CAC) and how many months of gross margin it takes to earn it back. Send the sales and marketing spend for a period and the new customers won in that period, and either the monthly revenue per new customer with the gross margin percent, or the monthly gross margin per customer in money. Get back CAC, the monthly gross margin per customer, the payback in months (exact and the month it is reached), and, if you send a monthly churn percent, the expected customer lifetime, lifetime gross margin (LTV) and LTV to CAC. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/cac-payback). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

acquisition_spend.description: Sales and marketing spend you count as acquisition cost for the period.

gross_margin_percent.description: Gross margin in percent (80 for 80%), applied to the monthly revenue.

label.description: Optional label, e.g. 'Q3 paid search' (your own text, echoed).

monthly_churn_percent.description: Optional: monthly customer churn in percent (2 for 2%), for lifetime, LTV and LTV to CAC.

monthly_gross_margin_per_customer.description: Or: the monthly gross margin per customer in money (instead of revenue and percent).

monthly_revenue_per_customer.description: Average monthly recurring revenue per new customer (send with gross_margin_percent).

new_customers.description: New customers won in the same period (at least 1).

name: cac_payback
title: CAC Payback Months
